items.scope:
CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in software, services, and open-source projects developed, maintained, or distributed by Anthropic. This includes Claude Code, Claude Desktop, browser extensions, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDKs and reference servers, Anthropic API client SDKs, and related developer tooling published under the Anthropic, anthropic-experimental, and modelcontextprotocol GitHub organizations.

Frontier AI Researcher CVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs) Pilot Scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Acer issues only.
Pandora FMS, Pandora ITSM, and Pandora RC issues only.
SailPoint issues only.
All WatchDog products.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Netskope products and services.
Caliptra Project components and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
